tools.name: track_awb
tools.description: Track an air-cargo shipment by its air waybill (AWB) number. Accepts any format ("176-1234 5675", "17612345675"). Returns status, route, milestones.

tools.name: resolve_awb_prefix
tools.description: Resolve a 3-digit IATA AWB prefix to its airline (name, IATA code, cargo tracking site). The air equivalent of a container-prefix lookup.

tools.name: air_rate_quote
tools.description: Get an all-in per-kg air-freight rate quote for a lane. Computes chargeable weight (max of gross vs volumetric) and applies weight breaks + fuel/security surcharges.
